title: SCP-548, Ice Spider
description: A small blue spider… and you begin to freeze.
body:
Ice Spider adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-548, also known as the Ice Spider.


SCP-548 is a small but extremely dangerous anomalous entity. Unlike ordinary spiders, SCP-548 appears as a cobalt-blue tarantula. While small, its true threat lies in its venom. Any player or entity attacked by the Ice Spider begins to suffer from Frostbite, a freezing effect that can turn deadly quickly.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-548 spawn?

SCP-548 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only one instance of SCP-548

</details>



![SCP-548](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca5bd647b505998bdf96b34dd750705616d581d5.png)

SCP-548, known as the Ice Spider, is a small cobalt-blue tarantula-like creature with a deceptively harmless appearance. It has low to moderate health and relies entirely on its anomalous frost-based attack rather than raw strength. When SCP-548 attacks a target, it applies Frostbite, a freezing condition that gradually drains health and reduces mobility. As the health drops below 12, the victim will be set immobile, unable to move as their body freezes solid.
